title: Anyone ever been here?
content: I’m just now realizing this is a thing and absolutely floored and freaked out. This is like a restaurant club place in a mall I’ve been to. The mall I go to is super sophisticated and classy feeling. Not like your typical American mall. The only thing I can relate it to is this random call of duty map on modern warfare called Hotel. When I first played that map I kept tripping about how much it looked like somewhere I’ve been in my dreams.
